# Modal — Modal for Startups

Free GPU credits (quantity not published) plus engineering and GTM support, in two VC-funding-gated tiers. Credits are a one-time grant per tier and applicants must be new to Modal.

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Seed to Series A | — | Raised any amount of VC funding from our VC partner network | A partner improves the offer, but is not required |
| Scaling and Series B+ | — | Raised VC funding > $30m or post-series B | A partner code is required |

### Not covered

- Existing Modal customers

> **Stacking:** Credits are a one-time grant and you may not reapply once you have received credits in a given tier.
